own_policy.line_key: tagged JSON [doc.id,id,lineId] or [doc.id,position,original1BasedRow] for legacy missing lineId
own_policy.stable_line_identity: existing valid lineId survives date changes/reorder; legacy positional fallback has no stability guarantee
own_policy.label: own ISO date + own existing document ID; line also has current original 1-based row number before filters
own_policy.default_order: display date/document/row label with ko numeric comparison; not opaque lineId order
own_policy.explicit_sort: existing stable priority then default-axis tie order
own_policy.single_line_axis: own summary still groups distinct own rows; original checkAggregate mode flag not promoted to server equivalence
own_policy.drilldown: not linked; exact original document/row filter unknown
